test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The train will arrive __with five minutes__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **in five minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**with**" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• Here, "**in**" is the correct preposition to indicate that the train is expected to arrive within a period of five minutes. 
 
• "**In**" is the correct preposition to use when referring to a specific amount of time before an event.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

**Corrected sentence**: *The train will arrive in five minutes. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**On**" is used for specific dates or days of the week.
 
• "**At**" is used for specific times.
 
• "**By**" is used to indicate the latest possible time something will happen.
